title: Vesper and the Debt
author: Ulyana Ravensworth
blurb: Noor Halloran, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
